assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete 2D fighting-game background, landscape 1536 x 1024, fully opaque. Reference image 1 is an authentic episode still of Striker's mine hideout from Helluva Boss, Western Energy, Season 2 Episode 4; use ONLY its environment as the design reference. This is a documented AU gameplay reconstruction of the intact cavern before the van crash. Preserve the angular blue-grey rock formations, purple/mauve rock walls, curved blue-silver railway rails over reddish timber sleepers, rails looping upward at the side and crossing higher in the cavern, small bright cyan orb lamps on tiny dark ground studs beside the tracks, restrained orange light reflected from a side crevice. No snow or ice. Remove every character, living figure, restraint, weapon and statue from the reference. Frame a wide side-view arena with level horizon and a broad continuous blue-grey stone foreground extending across the entire bottom 30 percent. This empty flat front stone lane is the deliberate AU adaptation, with low detail and a legible horizontal ground plane. Keep the curved rails and their cyan lamps in the middle/background, behind the fighting lane. No radio, free-standing rail prop, furniture or foreground obstacles: separate props will be layered later. Clean black/dark navy ink edges, angular painted 2D animation shapes, restrained cel shading, subtle light gradients, coherent show palette. Preserve the characteristic mine design, not a generic western saloon, desert or icy cave. No text, labels, UI, watermark, border, collage or multiple panels. One empty environment only.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete 2D fighting-game background, landscape 1536 x 1024, fully opaque. Visual references are authentic production backgrounds of the infernal courtroom in Helluva Boss Mastermind, Season 2 Episode 11. Reference 1 defines the axial court architecture; reference 2 clarifies the throne, sharp platforms and gallery structure. Preserve its distinctive saturated crimson/magenta and deep purple palette, tall red gallery columns bearing huge BLACK OVAL EYES with a narrow vertical slit, curved ascending tiers of dark pointed judicial balconies, sharp red-black rock-like throne structures, the central tier crest, the intensely orange-lit abyss below, hanging shallow black fire bowls with red rims and thin straight gold/orange suspension lines. Keep the tiered empty court as the dominant middle and upper background, with gallery balconies flanking it and restrained warm underlighting from the pit. This is an AU gameplay reconstruction: add a broad empty continuous dark red stone FRONT BALCONY, level side-view surface across the entire bottom 28 percent, with a calm low-contrast readable fighting lane. Behind this lane retain a clearly visible separation and orange depth down into the original pit, so this does not become a normal flat throne room. Gentle perspective, level horizon. No witness stand or near decorative railing in the front lane; those props are separate layers. Clean angular 2D animation architecture, sharp dark linework, controlled painted glow, simple cel shading; match the references' shapes and color hierarchy. No characters, silhouettes of people, dialogue, text, labels, signs, UI, watermark, border, collage or multiple panels. Do not replace the court with a generic medieval palace. stageDesign.floor: Court panneau de balustrade à pommes et serpent en avant-plan droit ; balcon central libre.
stageDesign.ambient: Lueur orange fixe, partition procédurale originale Audience sur les braises ; aucune reprise de chanson.

stageDesign.floor: Segment de grille dorée à cinq pointes de flèche en avant-plan gauche ; approche claire dégagée.
